title: Asking for directions
context: You're lost and looking for the metro station.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.hanzi: 你好，需要帮助吗？
turns.pinyin: nǐ hǎo, xūyào bāngzhù ma?
turns.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ, ㄒㄩㄧㄠˋ ㄅㄤㄓㄨˋ ㄇㄚ˙?
turns.translation: Hello, do you need help?
turns.text: 你好，需要帮助吗？
turns.romanization: nǐ hǎo, xūyào bāngzhù ma?
turns.translation_en: Hello, do you need help?
turns.translation_id: Halo, butuh bantuan?

choices.translation: Excuse me, where is the metro station?
choices.feedback: 请问 opens the question politely; 在哪儿 asks for the place.
For locations use 在, not 是.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.hanzi: 地铁站不远，一直走，五分钟就到。
turns.pinyin: dìtiězhàn bù yuǎn, yìzhí zǒu, wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào.
turns.zhuyin: ㄉㄧˋㄊㄧㄝˇㄓㄢˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄩㄢˇ, ㄧˋㄓˊ ㄗㄡˇ, ㄨˇ ㄈㄣㄓㄨㄥ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄉㄠˋ.
turns.translation: It's not far: go straight and you'll get there in five minutes.
turns.text: 地铁站不远，一直走，五分钟就到。
turns.romanization: dìtiězhàn bù yuǎn, yìzhí zǒu, wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào.
turns.translation_en: It's not far: go straight and you'll get there in five minutes.
turns.translation_id: Tidak jauh: lurus terus dan sampai dalam lima menit.

choices.feedback: 不客气 is said by the person receiving thanks, not the one giving them.

context_en: You're lost and looking for the metro station.
context_id: Kamu tersesat dan mencari stasiun metro.

title: At the hotel

choices.feedback: With a reservation made, first confirm your name.

turns.translation: Very well, Ms. Ana. Your room is 305.
turns.text: 好的，安娜女士。您的房间是三零五。
turns.romanization: hǎo de, ānnà nǚshì. nín de fángjiān shì sān líng wǔ.

choices.pinyin: xièxie. qǐngwèn, jǐ diǎn yǒu zǎofàn?
choices.zhuyin: ㄒㄧㄝˋㄒㄧㄝ˙. ㄑㄧㄥˇㄨㄣˋ, ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄗㄠˇㄈㄢˋ?

Sounds strange: just saying thanks would suffice.

turns.zhuyin: ㄗㄠˇㄕㄤ˙ ㄑㄧ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄉㄠˋ ㄕˊ ㄉㄧㄢˇ. ㄓㄨˋ ㄋㄧㄣˊ ㄖㄨˋㄓㄨˋ ㄩˊㄎㄨㄞˋ!

turns.text: 早上七点到十点。祝您入住愉快！

title: Making friends
context: In a café, a Chinese student sits next to you.

turns.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄧㄝˇ ㄒㄧˇㄏㄨㄢ˙ ㄓㄜˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄎㄚㄈㄟㄉㄧㄢˋ ㄇㄚ˙?

choices.pinyin: duì, wǒ chángcháng lái. nǐ ne?

choices.translation: Yes, I come often. And you?
choices.feedback: You return the question with 你呢: lively conversation.
认识 is for knowing people; it doesn't fit here.

turns.hanzi: 我每天都来！你是留学生吧？你的汉语很好！

turns.translation: I come every day! You're a foreign student, right? Your Chinese is very good!
turns.text: 我每天都来！你是留学生吧？你的汉语很好！
turns.romanization: wǒ měitiān dōu lái! nǐ shì liúxuéshēng ba? nǐ de hànyǔ hěn hǎo!
turns.translation_en: I come every day! You're a foreign student, right? Your Chinese is very good!
turns.translation_id: Saya datang setiap hari! Kamu mahasiswa asing, kan? Bahasa Mandarinmu sangat bagus!

choices.pinyin: nǎli nǎli, wǒ hái zài xuéxí.
choices.zhuyin: ㄋㄚˇㄌㄧ˙ ㄋㄚˇㄌㄧ˙, ㄨㄛˇ ㄏㄞˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊㄒㄧˊ.

choices.zhuyin: ㄉㄨㄟˋ, ㄨㄛˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄏㄢˋㄩˇ ㄈㄟㄔㄤˊ ㄏㄠˇ.
